instruction.text: A builder charges £12.50 per hour for labour, plus a fixed £22 call-out fee. Build a formula for C, the total cost, in terms of 𝘩, hours of labour.

atoms.instruction: Use your formula to calculate the total cost for 4 hours of work.
Use your formula to calculate the total cost for 10 hours of work.

instruction.text: A painter charges £15 per hour, plus a £10 service fee, and then adds 10% VAT to everything. Build a formula for C, the total cost, in terms of 𝘩, hours.
instruction.sound: A painter charges £15 per hour, plus a 10 pound service fee, and then adds 10% VAT to everything. Build a formula for C, the total cost, in terms of h, hours.

atoms.instruction: Use your formula to calculate the total cost for a 6-hour job.
Use your formula to calculate the total cost for an 8-hour job.

instruction.text: When hiking, Mia walks on easy sections at an average speed of 5.5 km per hour for 𝘮 hours. She walks on difficult sections at an average speed of 3 km per hour for 𝘵 hours. Build a formula for D, the total distance she hikes, in terms of 𝘮 and 𝘵.

atoms.instruction: Use your formula to calculate the total distance travelled after 2 hours on flat ground and 5 hours uphill.
Use your formula to calculate the total distance travelled after 6 hours on flat ground and a 3 hours uphill.

trainers.instruction: A scientist is observing bacteria. Initially, the population is 150, and it increases at a rate of 2 times the square of the number of hours of growth. Build a formula for P, the total population, in terms of 𝘵, hours of growth.

atoms.instruction: Use your formula to calculate the population after 3 hours.
Use your formula to calculate the population after 9 hours.
